# Legacy dataset fixture

`legacy-series-major/` was generated by the unmodified `metrics_dataset` at
commit `4e02dc5dc840188d0410cd83990ce360bc0ae31b`, built with Go 1.23.9.
Its configurations are the eight distributions in `fixture` in
`dataset_test.go`: 16 base series, 96 samples, partial churn, and one small
remote-write file. It preserves the original manifest identity and omits
`sample_order`.

Generation options: start `2025-01-01T00:00:00Z`, end `2025-01-01T00:00:11Z`,
interval `2s`, seed `42`, replica `7`, churn rate `0.5`, churn interval `4s`,
and maximum `1000` samples per request. The test verifies this unchanged
legacy artifact and compares its decoded logical samples to newly generated
output. Do not regenerate it with the timestamp-first generator.
